actions.name: export_trip
actions.description: Export one trip's itinerary, bookings and ideas as JSON or CSV for a human download. Local times keep their zones.

actions.name: list_sources
actions.description: List mail and calendar accounts granted to Travel with history range, coverage, last update, pending and failed counts, plus imported files, collections and data shared with chats.

actions.name: setup_source
actions.description: Choose the mail history range (30, 90 or 365 days) or the calendars to check for a granted account. A wider range resumes import for the older mail only.

actions.name: list_calendars
actions.description: List the calendars of a granted calendar account so the owner can choose which to check for trip conflicts.

actions.name: pause_source
actions.description: Pause or resume automatic updates for an account. Imported records stay readable.

actions.name: delete_source_data
actions.description: Delete what Travel imported from one account (account:<id>), from all files (imports) or from one file (import:<id>): its bookings, sources, search entries and calendar events. Notes you wrote are kept. The account is paused so nothing re-imports.

actions.name: continue_import
actions.description: Run the next bounded import step for one granted account now, with the same limits as the automatic schedule: one mail page with at most ten messages read, or one calendar page.

step.summary: Checked older mail, read 10 messages, added 2 bookings

actions.name: create_scope
actions.description: Create the data scope a chat may use: the chosen accounts and collections and whether it may change records. Called from the account access view with the host-bound actor.

actions.name: list_scopes
actions.description: List the data scopes shared with chats, including revoked ones.

actions.name: revoke_scope
actions.description: Revoke a data scope so its chat can no longer read or change Travel records.

actions.name: save_settings
actions.description: Set the home time zone, the names that appear on your own bookings, and whether the opted-in AI fallback may read confirmations that the built-in readers cannot.

actions.name: remember_view
actions.description: Remember the trip the owner last opened so Travel can reopen it.

actions.name: run_background_step
actions.description: The schedule's step. Recovers interrupted work, picks the next due account fairly and runs it. One bounded step: a Gmail page with at most ten messages read and a 20 second budget, a Calendar page, or a small batch reading booking attachments or the opted-in AI fallback. Records and the checkpoint commit together.

output.summary: Checked older mail, read 10 messages, added 2 bookings

actions.name: sync_step
actions.description: A scheduled ingestion step. One bounded step: a Gmail page with at most ten messages read and a 20 second budget, a Calendar page, or a small batch reading booking attachments or the opted-in AI fallback. Records and the checkpoint commit together.

output.summary: Checked older mail, read 10 messages, added 2 bookings

actions.name: enrich_step
actions.description: A scheduled enrichment step: read up to three saved sources whose booking is in an attachment, or use the opted-in AI fallback with exact passages. Suggestions wait in Review.

workflows.name: trip-check
workflows.description: Check a trip in this app for what is missing or conflicting, using only its recorded bookings, coverage checks and calendar events. Use when someone asks what is missing, whether nights are covered, or how a day fits together.
